entrance: The crypt on the island of Caer Darrow in the southeast of the Western Plaguelands. The door needs the Skeleton Key.

5343.objective: Collect the four deeds in Scholomance: Southshore, Tarren Mill, Brill and Caer Darrow.
5343.note: Southshore lies in the Reliquary, Tarren Mill in the room after the Chamber of Summoning, Brill in the Laboratory and Caer Darrow next to Lord Alexei Barov. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you into Horde territory.

5341.objective: Collect the four deeds in Scholomance: Southshore, Tarren Mill, Brill and Caer Darrow.
5341.note: The same places as on the Alliance side. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you into Alliance territory.

5529.objective: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings in the Great Ossuary.
5529.note: There are a few more than 20 in the room.

5582.objective: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink.
5582.note: A Plagued Hatchling drops the scale. Repeatable for Argent Dawn reputation.

5382.objective: Kill Doctor Theolen Krastinov, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff in his room.
5382.note: Leave Jandice Barov and Kirtonos the Herald alive if you want to do the next two quests in the same run.

5515.objective: Kill Jandice Barov and bring back Krastinov's Bag of Horrors.
5515.note: Turn it in outside to Eva Sarkhoff to get the next quest.

5384.objective: Put the Blood of Innocents in the Brazier of the Herald on the porch and kill Kirtonos the Herald.
5384.note: Keep the Spectral Essence you get as a reward: it lets you see Magistrate Marduke.

4771.objective: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room and kill Vectus.
4771.note: The chain starts with Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest and asks for two runs into The Rookery of Upper Blackrock Spire.

5466.objective: Use the Soulbound Keepsake on Ras Frostwhisper, kill him in his human form and bring back his head.
5466.note: Do not kill him as a lich. The channel takes 10 seconds, and he heals fully when he turns human.

7668.objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the basement of the Great Ossuary, defeat the spirits and kill Death Knight Darkreaver.
